what: Several step texts on the left and one sticky panel on the right — when the section spans from 20% below the top to 80% of the screen, the panel rises from .5 scale and transparent to scale 1 in .3s power1.out (when it leaves, it hides at .8 scale and transparent in .3s and pauses all videos). Each time a step text passes the screen center, only the video with that number plays from the start and appears in 300ms, while the others pause and fade out

options.fade: Opacity transition when video changes (ms), default 300
options.start · end: Range where the panel is visible, default top 20% · bottom 80%
options.--fx-size: Video width inside the board (css variable), default 100% — rgf 340/640
options.--fx-top: Position where the panel sticks (css variable), default 0
options.--fx-dim: Text opacity for non-current steps (css variable), default 1 (unchanged)
options.[data-fx-part=video]: Video inside the panel (the part sets muted, loop and playsinline). The step number can be changed with data-index
options.[data-fx-part=step]: Step text — data-active is added to the current step
